title: Selva
desc: Selva becomes friends with Kamini, a minister's daughter. However, when she gets kidnapped by a terrorist group, he strives to rescue her.

title: Theertha Karaiyinile
desc: A man meets a tuberculosis patient at death's door, and goes to his village.

title: Puthu Paatu
desc: When a woman falls in love with her brother's personal manager, she believes their connection is genuine. However, when she discovers he's already in a relationship she is devastated.

title: Jaisurya
desc: Surya, a fraudster, comes across an honest district collector, Jai, who is his lookalike. Things change when circumstances make him step into Jai's shoes.
